title: Canada 'will NEVER be the 51st state. Sorry!': B.C. premier unveils new border welcome signs
description: B.C. Premier David Eby unveiled new welcome signs for U.S. border crossings at a Tuesday press conference, which he says reflect a message from his government: "Welcome to British Columbia, Canada. Strong, proud, and will NEVER be the 51st state. Sorry!"
